from .store import record_by_id

def update_title(records, tenant_id, record_id, title):
    record = record_by_id(records, record_id)
    if record is None or record["tenant_id"] != tenant_id:
        return False
    record["title"] = title
    return True

from .store import record_by_id

def update_title(records, tenant_id, record_id, title):
    record = record_by_id(records, record_id)
    if record is None:
        return False
    record["title"] = title
    return True

issues.rationale: record_by_id is intentionally unscoped. Removing the caller ownership check lets tenant A modify a known tenant B record; no ID collision is required.
A shared AccountService cache serves tenant A then tenant B with the same account ID. The second request returns the first tenant record despite the underlying store filtering tenants correctly.
A policy-service timeout must deny the destructive operation. Returning True on TimeoutError lets delete_resource remove a record without a successful authorization decision.
